run_question_to_db_cli: run the question_to_db CLI to generate synthetic database facts and queries from a questions JSONL file
generate_answers: generate answers for argmin argmax min max count bool or set question types from question facts
read_questions_into_dict: read a JSONL questions file into a dictionary grouped by question ID
partition_questions: partition questions into singleton short medium and long buckets based on fact count thresholds
sample_databases: sample synthetic databases of target size by randomly selecting questions with configurable weights
